🇮🇷 Iran rolls out new tools to tighten control over Strait of Hormuz Iran's military is using new systems to better monitor the strait, Press TV reports, citing Iran’s Army spokesman Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia. Vessels attempting to navigate the Strait of Hormuz must do so in coordination with the Iranian authorities, as those who fail to do so face considerable risks, Akramnia warned. He added that the measures implemented by Iran allowed it to foil the plans of its enemies who merely use nuclear and missile issues as pretexts for pursuing other, hidden objectives.
